messages:
maria: ok team — first full draft of the launch blog is up. PTAL when you have a minute: https://docs.google.com/draft-launch-blog (comments enabled). Need: brand angle check, benchmark callouts, CTA for webinar signup, and a quick inbound routing note for Sales.
kevin: reading now. quick Q — are we still landing on the 'cost-per-token savings' stat in the lead paragraph?
mar ia: yes, kevin — we kept the headline focused on reliability + cost. the statistic in para 1 is from the Optimize beta benchmarks (avg 32% token cost reduction). i flagged it with [DATA-CITE].
sam: looks solid. suggest tightening the intro sentence. feels a bit long. also can we add a short customer quote in the second section? even a short paraphrase if we don't have permissions yet.
maria: good call. jordan, any legal constraints on paraphrased quotes?
jordan: paraphrase ok as long as we don't imply direct endorsement. keep it generic and mark as "an early customer". i'll sign off on the exact wording if you drop it in.
liz: copy note — change "seamless routing" to "policy-driven routing" in the product paragraph. more precise and matches the Console wording.
maria: updated that line. pushed a new paragraph for the webinar CTA — short and punchy: "Join our 30-min webinar to see real throughput numbers and rollout tips." does that work?
kevin: love it. add date/time placeholder and registration link placeholder. also, can we mention the webinar panel (PM + infra lead) so folks know the audience?
maria: done — added "with PM + infra". added registration placeholder `https://redwood.com/webinar/REGISTER`
sam: benchmark section: can we call out the workloads we used? ie. chat completions with median seq len 64 and long-form summarization at 1024 tokens. readers like specifics.
jordan: +1. just ensure we don't expose internal configs. say "representative chat and summarization workloads" then inline the token lengths.
maria: fine — added sentence and linked to appendix (we'll host a short spreadsheet).
kevin: editorial nit — in the "Dedicated" bulbs list you have three bullets. the middle one reads awkwardly: "Configurable autoscaling policies and burst capacity options" — maybe split to two bullets?
maria: split. thanks.
ops-bot: Note: scheduled publish checklist requires Marketing + Legal + PR approvals 48h before publish.
liz: who owns the HubSpot CTA mapping? need to map webinar registrants to the "product_launch" campaign utm and set lifecycle stage.
maria: sam, can you own the HubSpot mapping? it's small: add campaign=product_launch, source=blog, medium=referral, and webhook to the webinar provider for lead creation.
sam: yep i'll do the mapping and share the JSON mapping in this thread.
kevin: one more thing — can we include a short boxed callout that summarizes the cost/latency tradeoff? designers like a single data point.
maria: added a 2-line callout. asking design for a small visual. @liz can you ping design for a tiny graphic?
liz: on it. i'll request a 600x200 hero card and a small chart for the callout.
jordan: legal quick pass: i cleared the customer paraphrase and the benchmark wording. just keep the appendix link internal until we publish.
maria: perfect. final ask: who can approve for publish tomorrow morning? need a confirm by 5pm PT today.
kevin: i can approve copy once design assets are in.
sam: i'll confirm HubSpot mapping and webhook by EOD.
liz: design requested 24h but said they can expedite if we mark priority. i asked for priority slot.
maria: ok — tentatively planning publish window 10am PT Thu if everything aligns. if any blockers by 5pm ping me here. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: thumbs up
jordan: :party_parrot:
ops-bot: Reminder: add the blog post to the launch calendar entry (ID 2026) after final approval."
